# @amykit/plugin-file-brief-store

Briefs kept as one file per item.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `brief` port.

Use it when a workflow reads or writes briefs: feature-grooming waits on the brief port it mounts, prove reads the scenario a brief settled from it, and ticket-to-qa uses it when it is there. Each brief is a JSON file, kept under the project's artifact directory when there is one. It is the local default, and another adapter for the brief port can replace it.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `brief` |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-file-brief-store
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-file-brief-store"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-file-brief-store":
    directory: "briefs"
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `directory` | `string` | no | `briefs` | where briefs are kept, relative to the host-selected artifact root |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
